title: Week 2
priceNote: Prices are estimates from typical Aldi and Publix shelf prices and do not include tax. This week is lighter because it uses up what is left from week 1.
allergyNote: Nothing on this plan contains tree nuts or fish. Peanut butter and hummus are often made in plants that also handle tree nuts. If your allergy is strict, check the labels for a 'may contain tree nuts' line.
weekendNote: Festival days. Leftovers waiting for you: a portion of tikka masala and one bowl of tortilla soup. Two soup bowls and two carnitas portions stay frozen for week 3.
snacks: Hummus with cucumber and pepper strips

mon.heads: Lunch comes straight from Sunday's prep. Dinner uses the carnitas you moved to the fridge Sunday night.

wed.heads: Tonight, move Friday's soup bowl from the freezer to the fridge.

thu.heads: Tonight, marinate the tikka chicken for tomorrow. Five minutes.

prep.title: Sunday batch prep
prep.makes: 8 bowls of spicy chicken tortilla soup, 4 portions of shawarma chicken, a tray of roasted vegetables, garlic yogurt sauce, rice, 3 jars of oats, 6 eggs
steps: Start the tortilla soup in the crock pot: chicken, sweet potato, onion, garlic, jalapeños, chipotles, beans, tomatoes, broth and spices (low 7 to 8 hours or high 4).
Heat the oven to 425°F. Coat the chicken thighs in the shawarma marinade.
Roast the chicken on one sheet pan and the vegetables on another for 22 to 25 minutes.
Cook 2 cups of rice.
Make the garlic yogurt sauce. Quick-pickle half a red onion in lemon and salt, and chop the cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix 3 jars of overnight oats. Air-fry 6 eggs at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Slice the chicken. Pack 3 shawarma bowls and keep 1 portion of chicken and a cup of vegetables for Tuesday's wraps.
When the soup is done, shred the chicken in the pot and stir in the corn and lime. Keep 4 bowls in the fridge and freeze 3: one for Friday and two for week 3.
Move one carnitas portion from the freezer to the fridge for Monday.

prep.title: Thursday night
prep.makes: Marinated chicken for Friday's tikka masala
steps: Toss the chicken pieces with the yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, the paprika and ½ tsp salt.
Cover and refrigerate until tomorrow's dinner.

tortilla-soup.name: Spicy chicken tortilla soup

ingredients.qty: 2 peppers, minced, plus 1 tbsp of the sauce

steps: Lay the chicken breasts in the crock pot. Pile on the sweet potato, onion, garlic, jalapeños, 2 minced chipotle peppers with 1 tbsp of their adobo sauce, the rinsed black beans and the diced tomatoes.
Pour in 5 cups broth. Add 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano and 1½ tsp salt, and stir around the chicken.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours or high 4 hours.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and stir it back in with 1½ cups corn and the juice of 2 limes. Give it 15 more minutes.
Taste: for more heat, stir in another spoon of the adobo sauce. Keep 4 bowls in the fridge. Freeze 3: one for Friday and two for week 3.
tortilla-soup.tip: One pot that becomes Wednesday's lunch, soup night for two, Thursday's enchiladas, Friday's lunch and two lunches in week 3. Freeze the leftover chipotles flat in a bag for later.

shawarma-chicken.name: Sheet-pan chicken shawarma
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan.

Stir ½ cup Greek yogurt, the juice of 1 lemon, 4 grated garlic cloves, 2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, ¼ tsp ground cinnamon, 1½ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper and 1 tbsp olive oil together. Coat the chicken thighs.
Spread the thighs flat on the pan.
Roast 22 to 25 minutes, until the edges char.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice into 4 portions.

roast-veg.name: Roasted peppers, zucchini and red onion
steps: Toss the bell pepper strips, zucchini half-moons and red onion wedges with 2 tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp ground cumin and 1 tsp salt.
Roast on a sheet pan at 425°F for 22 to 25 minutes, alongside the chicken.
Cool and store in one container.

garlic-yogurt.name: Garlic yogurt sauce
steps: Grate half a cucumber and squeeze it in a towel until dry.
Stir it into 1 cup Greek yogurt with 1 grated garlic clove, the juice of ½ lemon, 1 tsp dried dill and ½ tsp salt.
Keep in a jar. It is good for 5 days.

pb-oats.name: Peanut butter banana overnight oats
steps: Mash one banana in a bowl and stir in 1½ cups milk, 1½ cups Greek yogurt, 3 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp ground cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Stir in 1½ cups oats.
Split across 3 jars and top with the other banana, sliced.
Refrigerate overnight. They keep 4 days.

breakfast-tacos.name: Black bean breakfast tacos
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, then wrap them in a towel.
Spray the skillet with cooking spray and wilt a handful of spinach with ½ can rinsed black beans for 1 minute.
Whisk 3 eggs with a pinch of salt, pour them in and scramble gently until just set.
Fill the tortillas and top with 2 tbsp cheese and 2 tbsp salsa.
breakfast-tacos.tip: Good fuel before Tuesday and Thursday pickleball.

hb-eggs.name: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs
steps: Put the eggs straight into the air fryer basket.
Cook at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Move them to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes, then refrigerate.
Peel and sprinkle with a little salt to eat.

shawarma-bowl.name: Chicken shawarma bowl
steps: If you have not pickled it yet, slice the ½ red onion thin and toss it with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Let it sit 15 minutes.
Toss the diced cucumber and halved tomatoes with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Build each bowl on a handful of spinach and ¾ cup rice with 1 portion of shawarma chicken, 1 cup of the roasted peppers and zucchini, the salad, pickled onion and 2 tbsp hummus.
Pack 3 tbsp of the garlic yogurt sauce on the side.
shawarma-bowl.tip: Built from Sunday's chicken, vegetables and sauce. Eat the third one by Thursday.

shawarma-wraps.name: Shawarma naan wraps
steps: Warm the shawarma chicken and 1 cup of the roasted peppers and zucchini in a skillet for 3 minutes.
Warm the naan in the same pan for 30 seconds a side.
Spread each naan with 1 tbsp hummus, add the spinach, chicken and vegetables, then spoon on 3 tbsp garlic yogurt sauce and fold.
shawarma-wraps.tip: Ten minutes after Tuesday pickleball, all from Sunday's prep.

carnitas-quesadillas.name: Carnitas and pepper quesadillas
steps: Sear the sliced bell pepper and onion in the dry cast iron for 5 minutes, then crisp the carnitas alongside for 3 minutes. Move it all to a plate.
Lay 2 tortillas in the pan. Top each with 2 tbsp cheese, half the filling, 2 tbsp more cheese and a second tortilla.
Press with a spatula and cook 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and melted.
Cut into quarters and serve with salsa, 2 tbsp Greek yogurt and a little cilantro.
carnitas-quesadillas.tip: Free dinner from last week's freezer. Two carnitas portions stay frozen for week 3.

soup-lunch.name: Tortilla soup lunch bowl
steps: Cut 1 tortilla into strips, spray them with cooking spray and air-fry at 380°F for 5 minutes while the soup heats.
Microwave the bowl of tortilla soup 3 minutes, stirring halfway.
Top with 2 tbsp cheese, a few jalapeño slices, a spoonful of Greek yogurt, a squeeze of lime and the crunchy strips.

soup-night.name: Tortilla soup night with a toppings bar
steps: Warm 2 bowls of the tortilla soup in a pot.
Cut 3 tortillas into strips, spray them with cooking spray and air-fry at 380°F for 5 to 6 minutes until crunchy.
Set out the diced avocado, cheese, Greek yogurt, sliced jalapeño, chopped cilantro, lime wedges and strips so everyone tops their own.
soup-night.tip: Dinner for two from Sunday's pot. Fresh jalapeño on the side lets each person pick their heat.

soup-enchiladas.name: Tortilla soup chicken enchiladas
soup-enchiladas.equip: small baking dish, air fryer or oven
steps: Spoon the chicken, beans and sweet potato out of 1 bowl of tortilla soup with a slotted spoon. Keep the broth in a cup.
Microwave 4 tortillas under a damp towel for 30 seconds so they roll without cracking.
Fill each tortilla, roll it and set it seam down in a small baking dish sprayed with cooking spray.
Stir the broth into ⅓ cup salsa, pour it over and top with ⅓ cup cheese.
Air-fry at 375°F for 8 minutes (or bake at 400°F for 15) until bubbly. Top with the sliced avocado and green onion.
soup-enchiladas.tip: Thursday's remix after pickleball: the same soup turned into a cheesy bake.

tikka-masala.name: Chicken tikka masala
steps: The chicken marinated last night in ½ cup Greek yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp smoked paprika and ½ tsp salt. If you forgot, toss it with those now and let it sit while the rice starts.
Start the rice. Sear the chicken in 1 tbsp olive oil over high heat for 5 minutes and set it aside.
Cook the onion in the same pan for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, 1 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp ground cumin and the other 2 tsp garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes, then stir in the coconut milk.
Return the chicken and simmer 10 minutes until thick. Season with up to ¾ tsp more salt, to taste.
Warm the naan and serve over rice with cilantro.
tikka-masala.tip: This week's new one, and a dinner for two. Coconut milk stands in for cream, so it stays lighter.
